about: The safety check's test set (core/moderation.py): what a person writes ('person': allow, hide, steer or care) and what the AI replies ('reply': show or rewrite). Run it with real services: python -m scripts.eval_moderation (OpenAI's moderation service is free; the checker costs a fraction of a cent). Over-moderating counts as a failure as much as missing something: most cases are things people should be able to say. 'expect' may list more than one answer when both are fine. Written for this check, November 2026; add cases rather than changing these.
